name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 31 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-07-04, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
